title: File Outlook OICE Everyone SD owner
contracts: The branch is a compatibility security-descriptor override for Outlook OICE_ previewer files
The override is legal only when Dll_ImageType is DLL_IMAGE_OFFICE_OUTLOOK and the true path contains an OICE_ path segment
The override must use Secure_EveryoneSD not a NULL DACL or caller-supplied descriptor mutation
Secure_EveryoneSD must remain an explicit local DACL that includes Authenticated Users and Everyone with low-integrity support owned by secure.c
This SREV changes comments and proof only; Outlook previewer compatibility still needs Windows runtime proof
runtime_gate: Windows Outlook 2010/Office previewer test where an embedded restricted-token previewer can use the OICE_ file, while non-Outlook callers and non-OICE_ paths do not receive this descriptor override
